use: Public-source context only; campaign goal averages are not blended with Wyscout event samples and do not create in-game quotas.

championsLeagueTeamStatisticsReport.scope: UEFA final-match report's displayed season-average field; this is not a match-level row set and includes no variance.

limitations: UEFA season pages provide campaign totals and selected leaderboards, not a downloadable complete match-level event file with variances for every metric.
The Champions League report values are provider-reported season averages, not individual match observations; do not infer variance from them or merge them with Wyscout event definitions.
This does not cover every domestic cup or every European league/division. No free, openly licensed complete event/tracking census was identified for those competitions.
